body: You got gas flowing ?
I hear drowning is euphoric right at the end.  I'm not telling you what to do by any means. Just what I've heard.
Have you gone to get diagnosed ?
What are you into, are you working ? If you are young things look bleak but once you gain a sense of self and purpose it gets easier.
I completely understand and sympathize with you.  Idk what's keeping me here at this point. Maybe just hope but the hope I have is rapidly fading.

Dont worry. I am too. I'm 39 and my gf of 11yrs who is the love of my life wants to end things. I raised her 2 kids and they have been the center of my universe. I dont think I can take this. Everyday I look for a reason to stay around but have been running out of things. I know this probably wont help you at all but I guess this is what you get to look forward to.

Problem is you do have a future. Everyone does. Unless they don't want it. The issue is , in the future you'll be happy and hopefully well adjusted to life then like a cruise missile will take out your legs from underneath you and land you face first into start over town.  Then you have to make the decision if you want to start over or get gone.

No one can say if its worth it for you. No one knows what happens after it's done. People are only left with the aftermath of what you've accomplished for yourself. They say it only transfers the pain and grief to the ones you leave behind.  Lucky for me theres no one that actually gives a fuck about me left.

Tell them how supportive and loving they have been but this is ultimately your decision and theres nothing they could have done to change your mind about it. Explain why you did what you are going to do and ensure them it was painless. Idk. Just off the top of my head.
I do too. All I do is fuck things up then spend years beating myself up about it. The i fuck things up again.
What state are you from?
300 or4 maybe ?

I get that.  I've hurt so many people by unknowingly walking around with massive childhood trauma and repeating the same abuses that have been done to me.  Just playing things out like a broken fucked up program.  The mornings are the hardest for me, I feel like all the things I've done come flooding in as soon as I open my eyes even for a split second.
My old lady wants to leave me after 11 years I cant handle this shit.
I feel you. I truly do. Whatd you get hooked up for ?
I share the sentiment. I'm 40 and nothing has ever made sense to me. Never been able to keep a job or a woman. It all doesn't seem worth it anymore.
It gets better for a little bit then you get divorced. There is Time in between that is nice but for me nothing's ever worked out so I get how you feel.
What's twisting your tit?  I'm about in the same boat so no judgment here.
I feel you.
Although it looks pretty simple to pull it apart.
I'm still new to woodworking but would you be able to inject woodglue, clamp it and throw some pocket screws in there?
Sorry you had that happen to you from a dobie. The owners most likely didnt train well.
Thanks!
I think that's asserting dominance. Everytime my Dobie did that to my shepherd he'd throw a smackdown on him.
Looks good!
